name: authoring-framework-skills
description: The authoring standard for the five AI Workflow Framework skills (analyze, deconstruct, design, build, test) and any other handsonai plugin skill that interviews a leader: the runtime rules for every line the leader sees, which lines are scripted and which are model wording, the teach-as-you-ask question format, entry, openings and closes, the light track, where each skill's files and approved lines live, the shipped scripts, evals and the review checklist. Use when writing, editing or reviewing one of those skills: adding or rewording a question, adding or splitting a phase, changing an opening, close or routing line, fixing a finding from a walkthrough or an eval, or the consistency review across all five before a release. Not for docs pages, lesson guides, or skills that never talk to a leader.
